FFmpeg notice
=============

This application may bundle the ffmpeg executable to provide hardcoded subtitle video export.
FFmpeg is a separate executable launched by Aegisub Translation Workspace; it is not linked into the application binary.

Windows build provider: Gyan Doshi / CODEX FFMPEG
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

FFmpeg project:
https://ffmpeg.org/

License information:
https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html

The Gyan Windows release builds used by this project are distributed under GNU GPL version 3.
The exact bundled FFmpeg version can be displayed with:

    ffmpeg.exe -version

FFmpeg source code is available from the FFmpeg project repository:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
